rv.q: Fly, You Fools! is spectacularly good. It could be a worthy successor to Operation Mincemeat if someone is quick enough to snap it up.
One does not simply sit and watch Fly, You Fools; instead, it is impossible not to be swept up within the chaos, comedy, and craft of this impressively charming piece of theatre.
‘Fly, You Fools!’ is a clever, entertaining and brilliantly orchestrated shoestring parody that could be even stronger with a little more chaos.
